description:
Initiate an outbound, webhook-driven phone call where your backend handles the conversation logic.

The agent must have a phone number attached and a webhook configured. This MCP connector prepends an automated-assistant disclosure to the greeting sent to the API; no tool argument disables that prefix. Calls made directly through the AgentPhone API or SDKs bypass this connector's disclosure logic. Returns the new call's ID, status, and the numbers it connects.

agent_id.description: The agent placing the call (ID from list_agents). The agent must have a phone number attached and a webhook configured.

from_number_id.description: ID of the specific number to call from (from list_numbers), when the agent has more than one.

initial_greeting.description: What the agent says right after the required AI disclosure when the call connects. If omitted, the call still opens with the disclosure and your webhook drives what comes next.

to_number.description: The phone number to call, written in full international form with a country code, like +14155551234.

voice.description: A voice ID (from list_voices) to override the agent's default voice for just this call.

name: make_call

agentId.description: ID of the agent that handled the call, or null.

endedAt.description: When the call ended (ISO 8601), or null if still active.

id.description: The call's unique ID (use as call_id in get_call).

phoneNumberId.description: ID of the phone number used for the call.

status.description: Call status, e.g. ringing, in-progress, completed, failed.

items.description: One human/agent turn of the call transcript.

response.description: What the agent said in response, or null.

transcript.description: What the human said on this turn.

title: Make Call
